KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. When practising Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.

1. D — Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu.

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 1.4.2 Vitenzi.

11. C — fupi

12. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 1.4.3 Vivumishi.
